title: Seven primary-process emotional systems are shared by all mammals

statements.text: Localized electrical stimulation of ancient subcortical regions evokes at least seven kinds of emotional arousal, named SEEKING, RAGE, FEAR, LUST, CARE, PANIC/GRIEF and PLAY. The circuits sit in homologous subcortical regions in every vertebrate tested, the evoked states work as rewards and punishments in learning, and comparable stimulation in humans yields comparable felt emotions.
